I especially appreciate how he stays up to date on advancements in HRT and shares that knowledge during our visits. Highly recommended. Thanks, Mike.

recent_reviews.title: Wonderful Experience with Defy Medical
recent_reviews.body: My experience with the clinical staff at Defy Medical has been phenomenal. Talking about personal medical and hormonal issues isn't always easy, but the providers make you feel entirely comfortable and heard. Defy Medical provides top-tier concierge health care. Their telemedicine platform is incredibly convenient, and the medical staff is lightyears ahead of standard clinics in their knowledge of hormone optimization and overall wellness. The initial lab review was highly detailed, and the treatment plan they built for me was completely customized to my body. Medications are delivered right to my door, and customer service is always prompt and helpful. I cannot recommend them enough for anyone wanting to restore their energy and take control of their health.

recent_reviews.title: So happy I switched to Defy
recent_reviews.body: So happy I switched to Defy. They listen to you. They don’t gatekeep medications. They know that women naturally produce testosterone along with estrogen and progesterone, so they are happy to prescribe a complete hormone replacement package. Hopefully someday insurance companies will catch up and these life changing medications will be covered for women the way they already are for men.
